contacts.title: Country Head France

description: French branch of Luxembourg-headquartered fundcraft, a digital AIFM / fund-operations platform providing management-company-as-a-service to third-party fund promoters and GPs. Opened a Paris office in January 2026 with Thomas Ibanez (ex-AMF) as Country Head France, then obtained AMF authorisation as an AIFM portfolio management company on 2026-06-24, allowing it to manage alternative investment funds in France. As a ManCo running many underlying client funds on one operational backbone, it is itself a direct buyer for multi-fund, multi-client NAV, subscriptions/redemptions, shareholder registry and fee administration - precisely Gaia's fund-administration module.

fit.reasoning: Fit 55/60: priority segment fund manager acting as a super-ManCo (20) + priority market France (15) + serves a diverse multi-asset-class client base of AIFs by nature of an AIFM-as-a-service model (10) + manages funds squarely for third parties, i.e. GPs/promoters, not proprietary money (10) + AMF-regulated (5, capped since the description leans more corporate-services than a classic asset manager, small discount not applied - kept at 5). Trigger 20/25: brand-new AMF licence (2026-06-24), no incumbent French system to displace yet. Access 8/15: named, reachable-profile Country Head France Thomas Ibanez (ex-AMF, so plausibly well-connected) identified via press and LinkedIn. Raw total 83, moderated to 78 pending confirmation of exactly how many underlying funds/clients it services in France today (self-reported ambition, not yet a confirmed book of business).
